Title: AI Memory Suite Governance Foundation
Content: First implementation slice for the AI Memory Suite plan: maintenance is warning-first by default through MemorySmith:Maintenance:AutomaticDeprecationEnabled=false, so low-score records produce DeprecationRecommended events instead of silent Deprecated status moves. A file-backed tag policy now lives at Data/Policies/tag-policy.json, and MemoryDiagnosticsService reports tag, source-link, relationship, staleness, and maintenance warnings without changing ranking or persisted memory schema. Context-pack JSON preserves records/warnings while adding schemaVersion memorysmith.context-pack.v1 and per-record diagnostics. The /memories workbench shows diagnostic chips and a selected-record diagnostics panel. Ranking changes, temporal decay, schema promotion, page chunking/frontmatter, and stricter Agent write behavior remain gated behind future council review and tests.
